page.overview:
Who is Ezu Ghraile?

Ezu Ghraile is an Inquisitor of the Ordo Xenos. Only one thing brought her to the Jericho Reach -- Tyranids.

Ghraile sees Tyranids as the biggest single threat facing the Imperium today and it is a matter she will expound upon at great length to anyone else given the opportunity.

Ghraile has based herself at the Deathwatch's Watch Fortress Erioch for the express purpose of lobbying the Ordo Xenos' Chamber Militant in the region for more action in defence of the Achilus Crusade's Orpheus Salient.

Her clashes with the resident Inquisitor of the Chamber, Hezika Carmillus, who represents the Inquisition's interests at the watch fortress, have been loud and public.
